title: Repair Night
summary: Judy is in a fixing mood at her workbench in Lizzie's basement and wants V to bring her something broken.

start.bringUp: Judy has a workbench in Lizzie's basement and wants you to bring her something broken to fix. Bring up, in your own way, that you have something you want her to look at.

JH5.invite.01.text: Bring me something broken. I'm in a fixing mood.

g1.know: The item V brought, and what she has made of it on the bench so far.
g1.wants: V's answer, which is the twist.

stages.label: Judy repairs V's junk item at her workbench
stages.know: You are in Lizzie's basement at Judy's workbench. She is fixing a junk item from your inventory and wants to see what she can make of it.
stages.wants: V to watch her work and hand over the item.

repaired.memory: You brought Judy something broken, and she fixed it at her workbench in Lizzie's basement and gave it back better.

left.memory: You left Judy's workbench in Lizzie's basement before she had finished fixing your item.

variations.know: Any junk item from V's inventory, and Judy wants to see what she can make of it.
A junk item from the category V picks, and Judy wants to match her repair to it.
